mapper.sql:
select course.id AS c_id, course.course_id AS c_course_id, course.title AS c_title, course.detail AS c_detail, course.class_room_id AS c_class_room_id, course.number_of_days AS c_number_of_days, course.registered_at AS c_registered_at, course.updated_at AS c_updated_at,
course_capacity.capacity AS p_capacity, course_capacity.number_of_applicant AS p_number_of_applicant, course_capacity.registered_at AS p_registered_at, course_capacity.updated_at AS p_updated_at,
class_room.id AS r_id, class_room.class_room AS r_class_room, class_room.registered_at AS r_registered_at, class_room.updated_at AS r_updated_at,
class_room_schedule.id AS s_id, class_room_schedule.course_id AS s_course_id, class_room_schedule.class_room_id AS s_class_room_id, class_room_schedule.date AS s_date, class_room_schedule.start_time AS s_start_time, class_room_schedule.end_time AS s_end_time, class_room_schedule.registered_at AS s_registered_at, class_room_schedule.updated_at AS s_updated_at
FROM course
join course_capacity on course.course_id= course_capacity.course_id
join class_room on course.class_room_id= class_room.id
join class_room_schedule on course.course_id = class_room_schedule.course_id
order by c_course_id,s_date,s_start_time
